627772.Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait from your trash to the hand.

627773.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 0]
[All Turns] Your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects.

627774.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2]
[Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block until the their turn ends.
627774.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, [Draw 1]. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

627775.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 3]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] From 1 of your opponent's Digimon, trash any 1 digivolution card for every 2 colors your Tamers have. Then, return 1 of their Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards to the hand.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains [Alliance] for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
627775.Inherited Effect: [Alliance] (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains [Security A. +1] and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

627776.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2]
[When Digivolving] If you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [ADVENTURE] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
627776.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.

627777.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 3]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Place 1 of your opponent's 6000 DP or lower Digimon as the top security card. For every 2 colors your Tamers have, add 2000 to this effect's DP maximum.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains [Alliance] for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
627777.Inherited Effect: [Alliance] (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains [Security A. +1] and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

[[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 0]
[On Play] By trashing 1 card with the [ADVENTURE] trait in your hand, [Draw 2]. (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)

627779.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If your Tamers with the [ADVENTURE] trait have 3 or more total colors, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait in the hand without paying the cost.

627780.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 3]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent's 5000 DP or lower Digimon. Then, for every 2 colors your Tamers have, return 1 of their suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains [Alliance] for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
627780.Inherited Effect: [Alliance] (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains [Security A. +1] and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

627781.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 0]
[Your Turn] While your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, or your Tamers have 3 or more total colors, this Digimon can digivolve into [MetalGarurumon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
627781.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] [Draw 1]. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card in your hand.

627782.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 3]
[Hand] [Counter] [Blast Digivolve] (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of the deck. For every 2 colors your Tamers have, add 1 to this effect's level maximum.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
ACE Overflow "-4" (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
